macros.name: firstlinenumber
macros.doc: \firstlinenumber{⟨filino⟩} brings about that (after it) line numbers less than ⟨filino⟩ do not appear in the margin.

macros.name: internallinenumbers
macros.doc: The command \internallinenumbers adds line numbers in internal vertical mode, but with limitations: we assume fixed baseline skip.

macros.name: linelabel
macros.doc: Set a \linelabel{⟨foo⟩} to the line number where this commands is in.

macros.name: linenumberdisplaymath
macros.doc: Number the lines of a display math in a {linenomath} environment, but do not in a {linenomath*} environment.

macros.name: linenumbersep
macros.doc: This dimension register sets the separation of the line number to the text.

macros.name: linenumberwidth
macros.doc: This dimension register sets the width of the line number box on the right margin.

macros.name: modulolinenumbers
macros.doc: Give a number only to lines which are multiples of [⟨number⟩].

macros.name: nolinenumberdisplaymath
macros.doc: Do not Number the lines of a display math in a {linenomath} environment, but do in a {linenomath*} environment.

macros.name: pagewiselinenumbers
macros.doc: Turn on pagewise line numbers.

macros.name: runningpagewiselinenumbers
macros.doc: When using the pagewise line number mode, do not subtract the page offset. This results in running line numbers again, but with the possibility to switch margins.

macros.name: setpagewiselinenumbers
macros.doc: Switch to pagewise line number mode.

macros.name: setrunninglinenumbers
macros.doc: Switch to running line number mode.

macros.name: switchlinenumbers
macros.doc: Causes margin switching in pagewise modes.

macros.name: switchlinenumbers*
macros.doc: Causes margin switching in pagewise modes.

envs.name: bframe
envs.doc: The {bframe} environment draws a frame around some text, across page breaks, if necessary.
